swapTest: 5/5 pass (Alert title+descriptionText+action+close, Inline notice descriptionText+close, Toast title+descriptionText+progress, Progress labelText+valueText+track padding, Empty state title+secondaryAction)
bindings: bloom/* colour roles only (no core status families, no Tonal-seed roles); radius/type/size through Theme set; literal geometry per the brief
anatomy: Alert: flat widget card (B.flat), radius/card 32, padding 20, gap 12. subtle = the tone pastel (neutral bloom/surface-high, info sky, success mint, warning butter, destructive rose, important lavender). The icon box is a 28 disc (= the 28 line of the B.heading title, owner header rule): bloom/surface disc with a 14 glyph in the status ink (bloom/success|warn|error, else bloom/fg). Title B.heading (Funnel Display 22/28 Regular) bloom/fg; description bloom/muted. strong (derived) = the notched-ink-card material: bloom/ink-card, bloom/on-ink-card title and 80% description, the tone pastel moves onto the disc; base rule hidden. Action Bloom/Button sm outline (B.outline 40 pill), close Bloom/Icon button xs outline disc; on the ink card both re-inked in bloom/on-ink-card.

Inline notice: B.chip language: transparent, 1px bloom/outline, radius/badge 15; theme-only 6px status dot (fills copied from Bloom/Badge per tone; important bloom/muted) in the label-line icon box (glyph hidden); word B.small Regular bloom/fg, description bloom/muted; Bloom/Button xs link, Bloom/Icon button xs ghost.

Toast: one ink float like the selection bar: bloom/hero, radius/input 28, no stroke, B.float shadow (effects copied from Bloom/Action bar). 28 tone-pastel disc on the B.heading title line (default/loading bloom/peach; loading Bloom/Spinner), glyph bloom/fg; title bloom/on-hero, message bloom/on-hero at 80%; action and close re-inked in bloom/on-hero. Timer = B.track on ink: 4px pill, rail bloom/field-edge, bar bloom/on-hero, inset 20, theme-only timer-gap 16 (visible = progress).

Progress: B.track: full-pill bloom/outline rail, ink done part (primary bloom/fg, secondary bloom/muted, status bloom/success|warn|error), 3/4/6 tall; label B.body bloom/fg; value Funnel Sans bloom/muted. Value still = track padding.
Progress circular (derived): bloom/outline ring, round-capped ink arc in the same roles; value Funnel Sans.
Skeleton: bloom/line bones; pill lines and round avatars (radius/control), capsule blocks radius/input 28 (lg radius/card 32).

Skeleton preset: table = Bloom order rows (bloom/surface rows at radius/input 28, 64 tall, 6 apart, no header or row rules); stats = white widgets (bloom/surface, radius/card 32); detail/form keep the base bone layout. Bones are Bloom/Skeleton.

Empty state: border on = flat white widget (bloom/surface, radius/card 32, no stroke or dashes); media a 48 disc (sm 40): first-use bloom/peach, no-results outline disc (1px bloom/control-outline), error bloom/rose with a bloom/error glyph; title B.heading, description bloom/muted; actions Bloom/Button md primary (ink pill) + outline pill.

sweep.detail: Data display 1: 67 Skeleton + 4 Empty state (Bloom/Table, Bloom/Data table; 2 deep nested overrides)

defectsFixed: Owner note 2026-10-31 (row tones, 'check the others'): checked. Bloom/Table and Bloom/Data table rows already carry the base tones (Paid success, Awaiting payment warning, Shipped info, Paid success, Refunded neutral); 0 changes needed.
Button fill-opacity overrides (Cupertino/Liquid defect): none in Bloom sets (0 of 358 Button/Icon button instances).

In-pass fix: swapped Bloom/Button instances inside the new Feedback sets kept the base size (28-32 tall, label overflowing the pill); 60 instances re-sized to their Bloom main height (sm 40, md 48) and set to hug.

In-pass fix: Toast timer rail first used bloom/on-hero at 25%, but a bound paint takes the variable's alpha, so it rendered opaque; and pastel bars disappear on the Dark ink. Rail is now bloom/field-edge and the bar bloom/on-hero, readable in both schemes.

fixes: Bloom capsule inner field-labels (theme-only text, defaults Email/Status/Note) re-filled from each Field's label: 22 (Customer, Shipping address, Carrier, Tracking number, Store name, Currency, Confirmation note, Work email, Password, Country) plus 12 standalone selects/searches (Status, Period, Search)
Orders sheet: Email and Tracking number rows hidden by the fit rule (as in the other groups)

ownerReview: Alert and Toast titles are B.heading (Funnel Display 22/28) so the 28 disc equals the label line (owner header rule with Bloom's smallest disc). In the narrow sign-in card the alert title wraps to two lines.
Strong alerts use the notched-ink-card material (ink with a pastel disc) rather than a darker pastel; toasts are ink floats like the selection bar, with tone only on the disc.
Status pastels map neutral surface-high, info sky, success mint, warning butter, destructive rose, important lavender (lavender is also the selection colour).
Toast timer rail binds bloom/field-edge, the only constant mid-grey role that reads on ink in both schemes (semantic stretch, pending a bloom track-on-ink role).

Screens: Orders sheet button group (Print label, Refund, Duplicate, More) overflows the sheet column; Dashboard Recent orders shows 3 of 5 Bloom rows (84px rows); both are density/geometry, not Feedback.

Bloom/Page key: its two disabled outline Button instances carry opacity 1 over a 38% disabled main (left as is: likely deliberate to avoid double dimming under the Page key's own disabled opacity; confirm).
Not addressed here (2026-10-31 follow-ups for all styles): small Avatar group clipping initials; disabled table rows keeping full-colour badges.
